## History

Aunt Mary is a married woman who has owned a special jug since the time of her marriage. Throughout her years of ownership, no one had ever broken the jug until recently. Her experience with the broken vessel was later shared by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) as an amusing anecdote in a letter written to her friend [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md).

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P1](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0001), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P2](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0002), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P4](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0004), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P6](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0006), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P8](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0008), +21 more_
